issue.title: Fix broken plan<->prompt links for 202607/sase_beads_memory.md
issue.description:
`just check` fails at the 'SASE validation' step (plan links validate) with 2 errors, unrelated to any source change:

  error: 202607/prompts/sase_beads_memory.md: 202607/sase_beads_memory.md is missing a valid 'prompt' link (reverse-link)
  error: 202607/sase_beads_memory.md: missing 'prompt' link to 202607/prompts/sase_beads_memory.md (missing-link)

Reproduce with `just validate` (or `sase plan links validate`). The hint suggests `sase plan links repair --write` can restore the inferable bidirectional links. This blocks `just check` from reaching the test step for every agent working in this repo.

Discovered while working sase-co (ACE PNG snapshot drift); left out of scope there since it touches the plans sidecar, not the visual suite.

payload.entry: Closed during open task-bead audit on master d462e97bb. Current sase validate is green, including plan links validate. Plans sidecar history shows 5aa2ae37 docs: link sase_beads_memory prompt provenance after the original broken-link report, so the reported missing prompt/plan backlink is stale.
